description.en: The description of the plug-in. The description can contain a maximum of 200 characters in length.
The statement that is used to modify the plug-in definition.

description.zh: 指定要修改的API网关插件的ID
description.en: The ID of the plug-in whose information you want to modify.

description.zh: 插件名称。支持大小写英文字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）、长度为[4,50]个字符, 且不能以下划线开头。
description.en: The name of the plug-in. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). However, it cannot start with an underscore.

description.zh: 指定规则所适用的对象标签，可设置多个。
description.en: The tag of objects that match the rule. You can specify multiple tags.

description.zh:
标签键。

n 的取值范围为 `[1, 20]`
description.en:
The key of the tag.

N can be an integer from 1 to 20.\`\`

description.zh:
标签值。

n 的取值范围为 `[1, 20]`
description.en:
The value of the tag.

N can be an integer from 1 to 20.\`\`

descriptions.zh:
- 此接口面向开放API的用户。
- 插件不允许重名。
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API providers.

- The name of the plug-in must be unique.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi modify-plugin --plugin-id a96926e82f994915a8da40a119374537 --plugin-name modifyCors --plugin-data Plugin_definition --description modify_plugin_first --tag Value=example-string Key=env --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi ModifyPlugin --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key env --PluginName modifyCors --Description modify_plugin_first --PluginData Plugin_definition --Tag.1.Value 'example-string' --PluginId a96926e82f994915a8da40a119374537
